correctness.rationale: For any shattered set, its all-positive labeling must fit each connected query component into a triple. Mixed labeling rules out cycles, and triple size permits only K2 and P3; saturation (p,q)=(m,0),(m-1,1) forces prohibited pair positives. Conversely any nonexceptional (p,q) admits an explicit initial partition. When p+q<=m-1, a free triple provides 3 transferable vertices; when p+q=m,q>=2, each edge box provides one movable vertex. With at most two movable vertices in any path box, each box has enough outside source vertices; for subsets of vacancies meeting two boxes, all movable vertices are Hall neighbors, so Hall matching realizes any target labeling without reversing retained positive pairs. Labeled graph counting gives factorial coefficient; max sizes are exactly (m-1,0) and (m-2,2). Replayed direct full-support enumeration for n=3,6 and all 34 canonical profiles m=1..4. All domains, special m=1 case and proof limitations stated; this finite verification is not asserted as an infinite proof.

originality.rationale: The all-m fixed-three-block graph characterization, precise two saturated forbidden profiles and full labeled support polynomial are not implied by checked close sources. The 2014 JMLR paper directly studies same-block equivalence concepts, but permits arbitrary class sizes and only derives Θ(n) VC bounds; its matching-shattering lower bound can actually fail under the exact-three restriction. Checked later work studies query complexity, not static all-labelings support profiles. Related published records and accessible prior claims concern different classes or invariants. Remaining unsearched historical mathematical literature is an explicit priority risk, not evidence of uniqueness.
residual_risks: Historical priority is not exhausted: an older combinatorics/learning-theory theorem for perfect 3-uniform partitions could cover the result under different notation.
Public published-finding corpus search operates on ranked summaries; absence of a close result is not a uniqueness proof.
The four inspected primary papers span direct related frameworks but cannot categorically exclude every appendix or all related publications.

value.rationale: Fixed equal-size triple clustering is a natural restriction of same-block equivalence queries. The classification detects exactly two globally saturated obstructions beyond local transitivity; they have meaningful combinatorial consequences not visible from an unconstrained equivalence-relation class. It yields every shattered support for every size, exact VCdim 2m-2 and entire labeled shattering polynomial and extremal-support count. This addresses a structural static-learning capacity, not merely finite examples or an arbitrary parameter slice.
